chat.t: [Web] You are invited to the 1st Donut House Donut Tasting Event!
Reply to this message to be contacted by our representative!

o: Donuts...
Interested

chat.t: Hello...!
I-I came to introduce you to some delicious donuts!

o: And who made these donuts?

chat.t: Well, um, I-I made them...
...I-Is that not okay?

o: So where is this place?
Can't miss out on handmade donuts from a pretty girl.

chat.t: I-I don't know about being a pretty girl, but...!
I worked really hard on them... S-So, if you aren't busy, please come meet me here!
U-Um, excuse me...!
The event is tomorrow as well, so p-please come back!

o: Wait, but how did you even get my number?

chat.t: Y-You registered for a Donut House membership card...

o: Is a police officer even allowed to use a law-abiding citizen's number for personal reasons?

chat.t: U-Um... I think calling yourself a law-abiding citizen is a b-bit of a stretch...

o: Whatever, I'm reporting you to the police.

chat.t: What? You're r-reporting us... to us...?

lines.t: Donut House

Since I didn't have any snacks at home anyway,
I decided to go check out the Donut Tasting Event.
Come to think of it, that face on MochiTalk... I feel like I've seen it somewhere before.

I arrived at the tasting event,
but something that had no business being there was sitting on the table.
Wait a minute, what is this?! Why is there a piece of crap sitting on a plate?!
I-It's not crap, it's a donut...
...A donut?!
I had to see the face of whoever was spouting this utter nonsense.
(This face looks strangely familiar.)
I-If you stare at me like that... I-I'll get embarrassed...
Ah, you're...!
Ah! Y-You're...!
That cop from before!
That e-escaped convict from before!
Ah!
I-I won't let you get away! Showing me things I sh-shouldn't have seen, blackmailing me, kidnapping me...!!
Back Alley
Ugh!
S-Stop! No violence!
B-Be quiet!!
P-Please calm down and...
Try some of this!

And just like that, my face was shoved right into the plate
containing that visually striking object.
(Urgh, is this how I die...?)
(But wait, this is actually pretty good?)
(It really was a donut? Why on earth did it have to look like... *urp*.)
P-Please come with me for a moment!
Phew... So, what did you call me here for anyway?
I mean, sure, I couldn't keep my promise back at the Panoticon to buy donuts in bulk, but I still became a regular at the Donut House.
Attempted bakery theft on March 17th... Dine and dash on convenience store ramen on May 2nd.
Y-You are currently registered in our Donut House system as an 'Empty Wallet Repeat Offender.'
A-And even though you call yourself a regular, you only ever take tons of free sample donuts...
(I want to argue, but I've got nothing.)
I-If you just review my donuts... I-I'll overlook these minor offenses...!
You? Why?
The p-police are busy too, you know... There are much bigger cases out there, so we can't go chasing down every tiny offense like this...
Hmm... Well, anyway. What's with the sudden donut review request?
Because... n-nobody will even consider eating my donuts...
S-Since you owe me, I figured... you could at least do this one favor for me...
Are you seriously blackmailing a starving man by taking advantage of his weakness?
You're brave to leave the reviewing to me.
...Fine, whatever. What donut am I supposed to review?
A-Actually, it's the same one you just ate...
Just, um, with different fillings... I guess... Ahaha...
You mean that piece of crap you just shoved down my throat?! No wonder nobody will eat it!!
I-It's not crap! I-I worked really hard preparing this donut for the competition...!
A donut that looks like crap is a whole other problem in itself.
There's absolutely nothing wrong with it a-aesthetically... Why is everyone ignoring my donuts...?
...Are you seriously asking that?
This was the only way to perfectly achieve the harmony of flavors I wanted...
I stayed up all night thinking about it, and this was the best shape I could come up with...
At this point, it's practically a crime.
That's... a very avant-garde donut.
If you just take one bite! You'll definitely taste my sincerity! Please?
(I-I feel like I'm getting dragged into something here...)
Downtown
I-It's delicious, right...? I'm very confident in its taste...!
Gasp! That guy is eating crap!
Tsk tsk, how starved must he be...
Ah, I just remembered I have some urgent business! I have to go!
Ah! W-Where are you going...!

I bolted out of there, worried that staying any longer
would trigger some incredibly weird rumors.

chat.t: Hello, how are you?!

o: I can't be well when I'm around you.
Who knows what kind of awful experience I'll have next.
What if I get rumored to be some guy who eats crap on the street?

chat.t: I-It's not that...
Round 2 of the tasting event is happening this afternoon, and I-I wanted to ask you to come!

o: Why do you keep looking for me?

chat.t: T-This time... I prepared an even more delicious donut!

o: ...You'd better not feed me crap again.

chat.t: I-I understand... And I keep telling you, it's not crap...

o: Face reality.
Because no matter how you look at it, it looks exactly like crap.

chat.t: *Sniffle*
... {player}?
Earlier at the tasting, you said something about my body...

o: It's nothing.

chat.t: What...? O-Okay...

o: Anyway, setting that aside.
Why are you contacting a law-abiding citizen?

chat.t: Ah, it's nothing like that...
Tomorrow is the last day of the Donut Tasting Event. You'll come, right...?

o: First crap, now a bomb.
I'm actually getting curious about what's next.

chat.t: I-It's neither crap nor a bomb...!!
A-Anyway! I-I'll tell you when you come tomorrow!

lines.t: Donut House
They say humans are bound to repeat the same mistakes, and yet here I was again.
This is! A n-new product we prepared at the Donut House! W-Would you like to try it?
...Hey.
Yes...?
What's with this big, black sphere?
And why is there a fuse on a donut?
It's a donut called 'Philosophical Inquiry of Existence and Explosion.'
That title smells dangerous already...
Why on earth are you researching something like that?
I-It's delicious, so please try it!
It's a one-of-a-kind donut that lets you experience existential emptiness and e-explosive pleasure at the same time!
No matter how you look at it, that's just a bomb.
You're not a cop, you're a bomber. I'm reporting you to the police right now.
I-It's really a donut...! And I'm n-not a bomber...
And you call yourself a cop? Is it legal to torture a law-abiding citizen with donuts like this?
Despite how it looks, it's the Donut House's absolute m-masterpiece...!
O-Once you try it, you'll understand right away...
Hey, hey! Put the plate down— Mph—!!
Mphf! Ah yoo fohce-feeding me again? (Mph! Are you force-feeding me again?)
Mphf... Thih ih furely thahsty? (Mphf... This is pretty tasty?)
Right? I poured my heart and soul into making it!
But still... Why on earth did it have to look like a bomb!
Only by creating donuts in various forms can we truly comprehend the very essence of a donut.
That's not what I mean! There's literally smoke coming out of this donut!
T-That's...! A f-fine detail to capture the imagery of an explosion. I-It's safe!
Anyway!
Ooh, so many donuts... W-Wait a minute!! This is a bomb!!
I-Is it going to explode?!
Heh. Looks like it's my turn to step up.
Hold on. This donut actually tastes much better than it looks, you know?
What? Who are you supposed to be?
As for me... I am Humanitas's greatest donut critic!
Humanitas's... greatest... donut critic?
Come on, everyone, try this donut! It's a life-changing flavor!
I don't know about changing my life, but it really looks like there's smoke coming out of it...
That looks like it's about to explode, so put it down and run...!!
It's not going to explode! I just ate one and I'm perfectly fine.
The only thing about to burst is her thick, luxurious, donut-fortified body.
Hmm...?
Aaaah! It e-exploded!
You s-said it wouldn't explode!
Wait, this guy just fainted!
Hey! You said it wouldn't explode!
Then don't tell me...
Am I going to explode too...!!
Freeze, everyone! Hands in the air!
We heard a wicked competition called the Donut Tasting Event was taking place here, so we came to deliver justice!
From now on, these donuts...
We will destroy them all!
D-Destroy them?! Not as long as I-I'm here...!!!
W-We're defeated!
To think a donut could overpower our muscles...
It's not over yet!
Your crimes are extremely wicked...!
I-I'm arresting you on the spot as terrorists!
You'll be severely punished for playing with food!
(I guess a cop is still a cop.)
(But isn't making a bomb donut also playing with food?)

chat.t: Thank you for participating in the Donut Tasting Event today as well...

o: It was no big deal.

chat.t: Actually... um...
{player}There's something I-I wanted to ask you...
Because it's a question only Humanitas's greatest donut critic can answer...

o: Wait, since when did I actually become a donut critic?
But a question only I can answer?
Might as well give it a shot.
Hey.
Did you find that thing inside you?

chat.t: Yes...! I-I think I found it!

o: Oh! How did you find it?

chat.t: The ultimate donut wasn't about simple taste or appearance...
It's that 'feeling' that stimulates a person's instincts...
A condensation of soft sensations, a momentary thrill...
Haa... Just thinking about it makes my legs tremble...

o: Seems like the cream will start overflowing soon.

chat.t: Huh?

o: It's nothing.

lines.t: Back Alley
Yesterday, I realized something.
While understanding the essence of a donut and boldly trying to grasp the truth is important...
having the confidence to push forward without caring about what other people think is also important...!!
(What is she suddenly talking about?)
Anyway, what was it that you wanted to ask?
Ah, well, you see...
Lately, I-I've been constantly wondering what the ultimate donut is...
So! I wanted to ask for your opinion, {player}! What is the ultimate donut?!
Hmm...
A donut with soft, pink flesh?
When you eat it passionately with your mouth and tongue, right in that long slit in the middle...
I-In the middle slit?!
A moist, fragrant, milky-white cream starts oozing out.
It's only real if it's so packed with cream that it drips all the way down the bridge of your nose.
And when you stick your tongue inside the hole... you get a taste of something tangy.
S-Such a donut...! I never even imagined it.
Laila, you already have that donut.
...What?!
Are you saying there's a donut like that among the 1,276 donuts I brought here?!
(They say people never realize what they already have.)
(I'd rather eat something else besides those 1,276 donuts.)
Mmm...
...I guess, if it's a donut like that...
This... Glazed Donut seems to be the closest...
I-It doesn't have cream, but...! I added strawberry flavor to the dough, so it has a slight pink tint...
...This must be Edea of the Donut that the greatest donut critic spoke of!
The most donut-like donut of all... The purest flavor that simply evokes the very word "donut"...!
Sigh... Laila, that's not it.
Huh?
The ultimate donut already exists within you. In a very deep, secret place.
Within me... Edea of the Donut already exists?
Yes.
I see... It must be an intangible d-donut!
No, that donut absolutely has a tangible form.
W-What an incredible realization!
To think Edea of the Donut is already inside me...
Though it would become an even more perfect donut if I helped you.
Want me to help you find it?
No! I-It's okay...!
Huh?
Y-You've already helped me so much... I'd feel too guilty to b-bother you any further...
I-I will find Edea of the Donut within me on my own!
I-I must go search for it right away!
...Tch.
